DISCHARGE SUMMARY Patient: KILCULLEN, SAORISE M MRN KC-0066-2150 Admit/ED visit: 10/01/2066 Discharge: 10/01/2066 19:30 Disposition: home with mother
Diagnosis: sprain of left ankle, grade one.
Brief sumary: 6 y/o girl seen in the ED after a fall at school playground on 10/01. Exam consistent with lateral ligament sprang. No fracture suspected per Ottawa rules. Advised rice and acetaminophen chewable 160 mg q6h prn x about 2 weeks. Gave school note for PE exemption through mid-October.
Condition at discharge: stable and ambulatory. Follow up: pediatrician in 1 wk.
Instructions given to mother Fionnuala and verbal teach bag done. Mother asks if she can take the sprain pictures to the Narragansett Tile & Stone HR dept for her time off note -- ok given. Patient lives with mother and her father Barnaby every other week (father Barnaby Teasdale picks up Fridays, not on the ED form).
Insurance: Member ID read to registrar as W K P dash four four one eight dash seven seven two oh dash oh three period
Disposition signed 10/1/2066. Mensah.
